title: |D|u||(O) ≤ |Du|(O) for locally integrable u
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, every open O ⊆ ℝⁿ and every u : ℝⁿ → ℝ locally integrable on O: bvVariationOn (x ↦ |u(x)|) O ≤ bvVariationOn u O, i.e. |D|u||(O) ≤ |Du|(O) with SimonGMT's variational definition (2.4).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (O : Set (Rn n)) (u : Rn n → ℝ), IsOpen O → LocallyIntegrableOn u O volume → Chapter02.bvVariationOn (fun x ↦ |u x|) O ≤ Chapter02.bvVariationOn u O
